label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Si Woo Kim leads CJ CUP
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 21-under par, finishing two shots ahead of Scottie Scheffler and Wyndham Clark at 19-under.

items.headline: PGA President Suspended
items.text: PGA of America president Don Rea was suspended for the rest of his term following controversial remarks about rider cup crowd behavior at Bethpage.

items.headline: Si Woo Kim Nears Earnings Milestone
items.text: Si Woo Kim is one win away from surpassing Bryson DeChambeau’s PGA Tour career earnings with a payout of $1.854 million at THE CJ CUP.
